about_the_game:
In Frontier Forge, an immersive crafting RPG and shop simulator, you'll build your artisan empire from the ground up through engaging, hands-on gameplay. Take direct control at the forge, anvil, and workbench, where your skill in crafting a huge range of quality medieval goods directly impacts your success and the outcome of each piece.

With your handcrafted wares ready, your entrepreneurial journey unfolds within a bustling, dynamic city. You'll proactively take your items to the streets, engaging directly with a diverse cast of characters – from common townsfolk and sturdy city guards to shrewd merchants and even discerning nobles. Their needs and willingness to pay will constantly shift based on city events, their own inventory, or the time of day, making keen observation and smart deals essential.

Every successful sale fuels your growth. Reinvest your earnings to secure your own workshop, acquire or build superior tools and crafting stations, and eventually hire apprentices to help manage tasks and automate production. This engaging loop of skilled crafting, direct street-level commerce, and strategic business expansion will see you transform your humble beginnings into a renowned and thriving enterprise.

content_descriptors.notes: The game will have combat and depiction of blood, like if you hit someone with weapons or hunt animals etc in the game.

  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 2gb
  • DirectX: Version 12

short_description: Craft. Sell. Build. Rise from nothing to become the city's top artisan! Frontier Forge is a fast-paced medieval crafting & shop sim where you'll forge your destiny, make shrewd deals with unique city dwellers, and rapidly grow your workshop and reputation.
